design.summary: Community birth cohort evaluating maternal exposure to PFAS
design.criteria: Singleton pregnancies with complete exposure records
design.susceptibility: Includes pregnant people residing near fluorochemical facility
chemical.name: Perfluorooctanesulfonic acid
exposure.name: PFAS serum concentration
exposure.measurement_method: LC-MS/MS quantified PFAS; structured interview for covariates
exposure.comments: Serum stored at -80C prior to analysis
exposure_level.name: PFOS mid-pregnancy mean
exposure_level.comments: Values reported for maternal serum at 28 weeks
adjustment.name: Maternal education
adjustment.description: Years of maternal schooling considered in model
data_extraction.effect_description: HR comparing highest vs lowest PFOS quartile
data_extraction.comments: Associations attenuated when additionally adjusting for breastfeeding duration

design.summary: Occupational solvent exposure among automotive painters
design.age_description: Workers aged 25-60 employed at auto plant
design.criteria: Employed at facility with at least 1 year tenure
design.susceptibility: Includes workers with previous dermal conditions
chemical.name: Benzene
exposure.name: Personal air monitoring benzene
exposure.measurement_method: Passive diffusion badges analyzed via GC-MS
exposure_level.name: Average mid-shift benzene
adjustment.name: Smoking status
data_extraction.effect_description: Difference in lymphocyte count between exposure quartiles
data_extraction.comments: Adjusted for age, BMI, and shift duration

design.summary: Supplementation trial evaluating folate to reduce arsenic toxicity
design.age_description: Women aged 18-45 with elevated well water arsenic
design.criteria: Arsenic in well water above 10 µg/L
chemical.name: Arsenic
exposure.name: Toenail arsenic concentration
exposure.comments: Participants provided clipped toenails at visits
exposure_level.name: Baseline toenail arsenic
outcome.comments: Evaluated among pregnancies occurring within follow-up
adjustment.name: Parity and BMI
adjustment.description: Adjusted for parity (0, 1-2, >2) and baseline BMI
data_extraction.comments: Intervention reduced arsenic biomarkers but effect on hypertension not significant

design.summary: School-based survey examining indoor PM2.5 exposure and asthma symptoms
design.criteria: Enrollment in participating schools with consent
chemical.name: Fine particulate matter
exposure.name: Classroom PM2.5 concentration
exposure.measurement_method: Continuous nephelometer readings averaged over 8 hours

adjustment.name: Household smoking and pets
